narrative.details:
While you are out there, it would be of great help to me if you could check on my traps for me. I've got them strewn all over the valley.

Bring back any small game that I've caught. Keep your eye out for the other wildlife, though. This area can be dangerous if you aren't paying attention.
narrative.objectives: Collect 8 Trapped Game from traps found in Sprung Traps in the Barrens.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you for your aid, champion. I was starting to wonder if I'd have to go to bed hungry tonight because this cursed wound on my leg.
narrative.requestItemsText: <Vrang grunts at you as you approach.>
